name: Hearts of the Lovers
summary: Carendin Halgar seeks the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to draw an incubus. Their longing for one another makes them an especially potent lure.

sections.title: A Scrying's Choice
sections.body: Carendin Halgar seeks two hearts for his work at the Temple of the Damned. His scrying points to Avelina Lilly in Ambermill and Isaac Pearson in Ratchet. Avelina serves the fallen wizards with her tailoring, while Isaac hopes to make his mark in the seaside town. Though they toil far apart, each longs for the other. Carendin asks you to bring him their hearts as a lure for an incubus.

sections.title: The Hearts
sections.body: Carendin receives the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson. He holds one in each hand and brings them together gently, then calls the lovers idiots.

faq.q: Who are Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson?
faq.answer: Avelina Lilly provides tailoring services to the fallen wizards in Ambermill, and Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in Ratchet. Their hearts yearn for each other.

faq.q: Why does Carendin want their hearts?
faq.answer: Carendin says an incubus is drawn to lovers' hearts, and that the deepest longing makes the strongest lure.
Avelina Lilly is in Ambermill in Silverpine Forest, while Isaac Pearson is in Ratchet in the Barrens.
Carendin Halgar is at the Temple of the Damned, where he asks you to bring him Avelina and Isaac's hearts.

attribution: In-game quest text: Hearts of the Lovers
